outgoingFlows.description: Susceptible individuals become infected with HIV through contact with infectious individuals and enter the acute phase. The rate depends on the 'Transmission Parameter Initial Value' and the 'Infectivity' of the source compartment, adjusted by 'Relative Transmission on ART' and 'Other Interventions Reduction in Transmission'.
Infected individuals progress from the acute phase to the chronic phase. The rate is calculated as 1 / 'Acute Phase Duration'.
Individuals in the acute phase are tested and immediately start ART. The rate is determined by 'Testing Rate' and 'Refusal'.
Infected individuals progress from the chronic phase to the final phase. The rate is derived from the overall 'Survival Median' and the durations of the acute and final phases.
Individuals in the chronic phase are tested and immediately start ART. The rate is determined by 'Testing Rate' and 'Refusal'.
Individuals in the final phase are tested and immediately start ART. The rate is determined by 'Testing Rate' and 'Refusal'.
Individuals on ART discontinue treatment at the 'Drop-out' rate and revert to the untreated chronic phase.

parameters.name: Initial CD4 Mu
parameters.description: Location parameter for the log-normal distribution of initial CD4+ cell counts.

parameters.name: Initial CD4 Sigma
parameters.description: Shape parameter for the log-normal distribution of initial CD4+ cell counts.

parameters.name: Survival Median
parameters.description: Median survival time for infected individuals, following a Weibull distribution.

parameters.name: Survival Shape
parameters.description: Shape parameter for the Weibull survival distribution of infected individuals.

parameters.name: Acute Phase Duration
parameters.description: Duration of the acute phase of HIV infection.

parameters.name: Acute Phase Infectivity
parameters.description: Relative infectivity during the acute phase, used as a multiplier for the base transmission parameter.

parameters.name: Chronic Phase Infectivity
parameters.description: Relative infectivity during the chronic phase of HIV infection, used as a multiplier for the base transmission parameter.

parameters.name: Final Phase Infectivity
parameters.description: Relative infectivity during the final phase of HIV infection, used as a multiplier for the base transmission parameter.

parameters.name: Final Phase Duration
parameters.description: Duration of the final phase of HIV infection, expressed as a proportion of the expected life.

parameters.name: Concurrency Number
parameters.description: Average number of concurrent sexual partnerships.

parameters.name: Partnership Duration
parameters.description: Mean duration of a sexual partnership.

parameters.name: Start ART CD4
parameters.description: CD4+ cell count threshold at which ART begins. A value of 0 implies immediate commencement regardless of CD4 count.

parameters.name: Proportion Tested Rate
parameters.description: Baseline rate at which individuals are tested for HIV (used for scenarios without intervention).

parameters.name: Monte Carlo Repeats
parameters.description: Number of Monte Carlo simulation repeats.

parameters.name: Birth Rate
parameters.description: Rate at which new individuals are born into the population.

parameters.name: Background Mortality Rate
parameters.description: Mortality rate from causes unrelated to HIV, affecting all compartments.

parameters.name: Transmission Parameter Initial Value
parameters.description: Initial value of the base transmission parameter, representing the force of infection.

parameters.name: Relative Transmission on ART
parameters.description: Factor by which infectivity is reduced for individuals receiving ART.

parameters.name: Progression Untreated
parameters.description: Mortality rate for untreated HIV-infected individuals.

parameters.name: Progression Treated
parameters.description: Mortality rate for HIV-infected individuals receiving ART.

parameters.name: Intervention Timing
parameters.description: Year when the intervention (e.g., testing and ART rollout) begins.

parameters.name: Intervention Rate
parameters.description: Rate of rollout for the intervention.

parameters.name: Intervention Maximum
parameters.description: Maximum proportion of the population covered by the intervention.

parameters.name: Testing Rate
parameters.description: Rate at which individuals are tested for HIV as part of the intervention strategy.

parameters.name: Refusal
parameters.description: Proportion of individuals who refuse HIV testing.

parameters.name: Drop-out
parameters.description: Rate at which individuals discontinue ART.

parameters.name: Failure Rate
parameters.description: Rate at which ART treatment fails.

parameters.name: Other Interventions Reduction in Transmission
parameters.description: Factor by which transmission is reduced by other interventions.

uncertainty_analysis.methodologyNotes: This task is **parameter uncertainty quantification**: documenting uncertainty about **numerical parameter values** in the .compmodel (not structural or stochastic uncertainty). Confidence is **mostly Unknown** unless a small built-in heuristic matches the disease name (COVID-19, Malaria, HIV) and parameter name substrings — assigning High/Medium/Low requires curated literature ranges or expert review; see Phase 1 README (Validity & limitations).
